Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill two months ago, extremely excited about my first Traeger, and I've used it about a dozen times. My thoughts:

The good:
-Food tastes pretty good (food also tastes good on a $100 charcoal grill)
-Very difficult to overcook anything 

The bad:
-Display screen is already failing (see photo, bottom left corner of screen)
-Meat temperature probe broke after 1 use (bad probe error sign whenever I plug it in)
-Despite what Traeger advertises, it does not sear meat. If I crank it up to the max setting, 450, I can get weak grill marks on meat at best
-Still haven't found a true smoke setting, even under 200 degrees it doesn't get smoky enough

Overall, this thing basically functions as an outdoor oven. The only benefit over an oven is that it imparts a woody flavor to the food. If you want to drop Traeger $$$ on an outdoor oven, go for it. If I could do it again I'd stick with a much more affordable and less frustrating charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Disappointing

Results.ReviewText: The PRO 780 Is my 4th Traeger (I still have and use all 4). The new D2 technology is really a game changer. At first when they came out last March I was like ok that's pretty cool but do I really need that in a grill? Well I can't tell you how awesome it is to be able to get home from work, fire up the grill and monitor my cook while I'm walking the dogs. I mean I'm literally mind blow that I get a push notification that my grill has preheated. It sounds over kill but it really does make a difference and fits my busy lifestyle. Not to mention the the grill is stout. Its sturdy, looks amazing and it has been re-engineered to be more quiet and efficient. You can control the thermostat in 5 degree increments as well. Guys, if your thinking about upgrading or adding a new grill to your arsenal. Do it. You wont regret the new D2 grills and your grill confidence will only rise! Way to go Traeger!

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this grill!  I ordered it directly from TraegerGrills.com.  I was worried about damage in shipment, but it was packed so well that there was it arrived in pristine condition.  I then unpacked it and found several surprises -- more on that later.  I began putting it together and the instructions, parts, and hardware made it seamless.  They even include the screwdriver, crescent wrench and allen wrench you will need.  I had it assembled in no time.  I do highly recommend you have another person nearby for some parts of assembly, such as flipping it over to attach the legs, as you'll have a higher risk of  damaging your grill if you do it by yourself.  Its very sturdy and heavy.  Once assembled, the instructions on how to start it up were simple and very easy to follow.  I did run into one small issue with connecting the WiFi portion, and I was worried that I'd be dead in the water since this was 4p on a Saturday, but I saw their support line was open 365 days per year from morning until evening.  I called and I was the 6th person in the queue.  It provided me the option to stay on the line or to keep my place in line and have support call me back. I elected for the latter.  In 2 minutes they called my phone, were very polite, well-spoken and wonderfully helpful.  They helped me solve the issue in less than a minute by asking me a couple of quick questions to assess where in the process I was running into the issue.  Now I was ready to grill!  I first seasoned it following the instructions.   Note: this takes about an hour, so plan on that, but it needs to be done.  Once that was complete, I let the grill cool down all the way because I wanted to see how long it would take to go from ambient temp up to 450 -- it was 23F degrees outside at the time.  To my surprise, it was lightening fast, and even better, I could see the temp increasing real-time from inside my house right on my app.    I then backed it off to the temp I wanted to cook at -- I had two big, juicy steaks to cook.  It cooked them perfectly!  I had two college buddies in town visiting this weekend and they both said the steak was phenomenal with perfect wood-fired flavor.  I used the Signature Blend of Traeger pellets.  My buddies raved about the taste even the next day.  I love this grill and am stoked with my purchase.  Now on to the nice surprises.  I have 3 young children (5, 8 and 11 yrs old).  When I opened the box after it was delivered, I could see printing on the inside of the box.  Well, if you turn the cardboard box inside out after unpacking it, it turns into a playhouse with the printing being a design that looks like a rustic cabin, complete with a window, a door, shakes roof, and an image of the grill in the front of the cabin.   I set it up in the kids' playroom and they had a blast all weekend acting like they were camping "at the cabin."  What kid doesn't love a huge cardboard box to play in? And the printing on it made so much better for imaginary play.  The second nice surprise is the assembly instructions come with suggested amount of your "favorite bottled beverage" to consume with each major step.   Every great assembly project needs the operator to be appropriately well-oiled with assembly juice, right?  I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Phenomenal Grill, Extremely Well Constructed!

Results.ReviewText: You cannot set the temp higher than 450.  Also, I complained to customer service that it took forever to ignite and then would overheat and would have to be shut down and restarted before cooking could begin.  I had to disassemble the fire box and adjust the heat rod MYSELF.  Traeger doesn’t offer to fix the problem, but DID offer that this is a VERY COMMON ISSUE.  Before you order, MAKE SURE you have some tools...  I remedied the temperature limitation by ordering a set of aluminum grill grates from another company for an additional $80 to facilitate searing after smoking and general grilling because otherwise you don’t really get the outer crispness and grill marks we all want.  Now I love it. Just wish, for the price, I didn’t also have to take it apart plus buy additional stuff.  My $0.02.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I bought a Traeger Pro at Costco which came with pellets and it worked great for 6 months. Bought another bag of pellets at Costco and the pellets are 2 inches long, glossy, and hard as rocks. Now my BBQ will 'auto shut-off' for low temp and 'auto shut-off' for high temp, and just having all sorts of temperature fluctuations. Since the BBQ worked great on the other pellets, I finally figured out it was the pellets. The problem I found was the new pellets are too long, and the auger can't break them up and jambing, causing low temp. When it finally surges and spits a ton of pellets into the 'firepot', it gets too hot. I contacted Traeger, and was told the pellets they sell on their website "don't do this". I bought Trager branded pellets from Costco so how was I to know? The grill gets 5 stars, C.S. gets 1 star making 3 stars. Here is the fix: I finally put some pellets in a bucket and smashed them with a sledge hammer. The grill works great now. Just cooked a tri-tip for 6 hours on smoke, no problem. NOW I just need to smash 33 pounds for pellets from Costco. Not thrilled.
Results.Title: Pellet problem, not BBQ problem

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I used to think I knew Traeger. I was wrong. The ability to do big smokes -- 15 hours or more is easy with the access to the facts is amazing. You can sit at your desk and manage your home smoke on a weekday that used to be only a weekend thing. Suck it up, spend the money and make brisket a par of your weekday life!
Results.Title: Step up and understand how great smoking can be

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: After researching pellet smokers for almost a year, I finally pulled the trigger on the 780 Pro. It has blown my expectations away, from the durable build quality, ease of use, and flawless operation. If you are on the fence as I was, save yourself some wasted time, rip off the band-aid, and buy one! Honest review, from a genuinely satisfied customer.
Results.Title: Perfection

Don’t get me wrong I love my Traeger 575 grill just wish it came with those sweet features. I wish I could return my Traeger and upgrade!!! Don’t be cheap and get the model I did. Waiting for my butcher paper to smoke a whole brisket. #TRAEGERFAMILY

Photos.Caption: Ribs after smoking, with smoke ring

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Treager Pro Series 575 about 3 months ago and I can say nothing but good things. I've made wonderful things, from ribs to pulled pork to Tomahawk steak. Used different kinds of woodpellets (Cherry, oak). I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the installation guide, it was quick and easy and I got it running fast. I've cooked for some groups of friends (16 in one sitting) and people were all impressed by how good everything was. It also saves time, because you don't have to check on the temp all the time. This is a very good grill, easy to clean, easy to use. Definitely recommend!
Results.Title: Smoking made easy(er)

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: This grill works exactly as advertised. Our first cook, a 10-hour slow roasted pork with applewood pellets, finished tender and flavorful. It pulled apart with ease. We have also made juicy burgers and perfectly cooked steaks using the mesquite.
Results.Title: Pork and Beef - all good!
